GOT QUESTIONS?
WE’RE FANS OF THOSE.

Need help choosing a figure or checking a delivery? The Dufflings team is a message away.

Talk to the team
How do I order from Dufflings?

Explore this sample collection, then visit the current Dufflings store or contact the team to confirm real products, prices, and availability. This HTML design preview supports a local shopping bag, but does not submit orders or accept payments.

How do pre-orders work?

Dufflings currently lists a 50% upfront reservation payment, with the remaining balance collected before shipping. Confirm the actual item, arrival estimate, and cancellation terms with the store before paying.

Do you ship across India?

Dufflings offers pan-India shipping. Message the team with your city and pincode to check delivery timing and charges for your order.

Can I ask for a figure that isn’t listed?

Yes—send the team the character, series, and edition you are looking for. They can confirm sourcing options and availability.
